t: The Signature Clean Kit: Graded Wipe System
title: The Signature Clean Kit: Graded Wipe System
description: The Signature clean kit grades wipes by job — white sealed-edge for boards and dies, blue microfiber for heatspreaders, gray microfiber for glass and bench — so the wrong cloth never touches the wrong surface. Each grade lives in its own labeled dispenser on the bench station. Grading ends the 'grab whatever cloth' habit that smears paste onto screens.

print("White sealed-edge: boards + dies. Blue microfiber: heatspreaders.")
print("Gray microfiber: glass + bench. Labeled dispensers on station.")
print("Right cloth per surface: grading ends 'grab whatever' smearing.")

t: Signature Bench Bottle With Metered Pump
title: Signature Bench Bottle With Metered Pump
description: The Signature bench bottle has a metered pump — one press damps a cloth perfectly, no pouring, no soaking, no waste. The pump seals between uses so the 99% does not absorb water from the air (open bottles dilute over time). A sight window shows the level. Metered damping is the difference between 'damp' and 'drowned'.

demo.program:
print("Metered pump: one press = perfectly damped cloth. No pour, no soak, no waste.")
print("Sealed between uses: 99% stays 99% (open bottles absorb air moisture).")
print("Sight window: level visible. 'Damp' vs 'drowned': the pump decides.")
